strings.subtitle: — Fail nas koron hor —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Tayom-jom re menea. Hoje-a button use kaa.
strings.shred_button: N A S   K O R
strings.ssd_warning:
Sanjog! SSD re TRIM karone upre lekha vidhi nas-ren guarantee menea.
Naa program HDD-re ghat.
strings.confirm_text:
Fail "{name}" upre lekha ar metai hobo.

Aago jom?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_title: ✅  FAIL UPRE LEKHA AR METAI DOHO
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS alternativ data stream (ADS) process menea hobo.
• USN journal saf menea hobo.
• Shadow copy ar cloud sync
  (OneDrive wagairah) afa menea hobo.
strings.status_full: Sabai taha pura sunya re upre lekha doho. Wapas menea hobo — hathiyaar khali sunya dekhi.
strings.status_fast: Boha, laa ar 4 MB patti upre lekha doho. Miti-re menaa, kintu khali jaga karone consumer hathiyaar-re pura wapas menea hobo. Gupt dastavej-re PURA mode use kaa.
strings.status_empty: Fail khali tahne, upre lekha-r jarurat menea tahne. Metai doho.
strings.error_permission: Fail tak pahunch menea. Koi dusra program-re khuli hobo. Band kor ar aro koshish kaa.
strings.error_not_found: Fail menea menu hobo. Hoi mano agu metai gel tahne.
strings.error_is_symlink: Naa symbolic link. Link nas menea hobo — target fail surakshit taha.
strings.error_reparse: Naa placeholder fail (OneDrive andoa samaan). Iska data cloud-re taha, disk-re menea — inaa nas koron ghat menea.
strings.error_not_file: Naa fail menea (folder andoa kuch aur). Fail tayom.
strings.error_hardlinks: Naa fail-re dusra hard link taha ({n} sabbai). Hard link-r koi primary menea — sabbai nuta barabar taha. Jodi vartaman rasta-re nas kaa, data upre lekha ar 32 byte tak katta hobo, kintu bacha hissa dusra link-re pahunch sakta taha. Agu sabbai link metai.
strings.error_compressed:
Fail sikda, encrypt andoa virla taha. Sunya-re upre lekha purana data nas-ren guarantee menea deta, karonki NTFS unke alag tarika-re rakhta taha.

Visheshta hata: daahina click → Gun → Unnat → "Sikod" ar/andoa "Encrypt"-re tick hata. Taahe SHREDDER aro chalaa.
